Red Lantern Corps

Bleez

A winged warrior of the Red Lanterns.

Bleez is a winged Red Lantern whose story gives the Corps a perspective beyond Atrocitus. The early ongoing series makes her judgment and position in the group central.

Continuity: Main DC comics continuity; this profile follows the cited era rather than asserting a permanent present-day status.

Affiliation
Red Lantern Corps
First appearance
Final Crisis: Rage of the Red Lanterns #1 (2008)
Story history — History and later developments — spoilers

Bleez comes from Havania and is associated with its royal family. Red Lanterns #3 gives her a spotlight and positions her as a potential lieutenant to Atrocitus. Her relationship to leadership is more complicated than always remaining a berserker or always being in full control. Begin with that early series for her changing role.

  • Red Lanterns
    Opening arc: #1–6 (2011–2012)
